prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/shelf-care.png in this repo. Use a square size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/shelf-moss.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the same plaster wall, dark pine shelf edge, camera angle and soft daylight from the left. Replace the object with a neat, spaced row of gardener's tools lying on the shelf: a small hand-tied bamboo broom, a pair of black forged-steel Japanese pruning shears, and a small hammered copper water mister. Group about 50% of the frame width, centred slightly left. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. Square 1:1.
